tools.name: decline_invite
tools.description: Decline a pending (status=invited) namespace invitation as the grantee. Server verifies you are the invitee (email/tenant match). Grantors must use revoke_grant instead.

tools.name: delete_fact
tools.description: Soft-delete a stored fact by its UUID (Smart Forget). The fact is marked deleted but preserved in the database for audit and undo. Excluded from all normal searches. Use when information is no longer accurate or relevant.

tools.name: get_fact
tools.description: Retrieve a fact by its exact key — deterministic, never misses. Use get_fact for self-notes: get_fact(key='agent:<name>:self-note:opening') or get_fact(key='agent:<name>:self-note:closing'). search_facts misses self-notes because their embedding similarity scores below other identity facts — get_fac

tools.name: get_fact_history
tools.description: Return the full version history for a keyed fact — current version plus all deprecated predecessors. Use to see how a fact evolved over time or to undo an accidental correction. Returns list of fact versions ordered newest → oldest.

tools.name: get_session_seed
tools.description: Return the pre-computed session seed for this tenant — a compact first-person bio (~500 tokens) describing who you are and what you care about right now. Generated nightly and on session disconnect. Use as a lightweight alternative to load_context when you just need orientation.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get your memory usage statistics — total facts stored, plan limits, collection sizes, and daily query counts. Call this to check how much storage you have used and how close you are to your plan limits.

tools.name: ghost_mode
tools.description: Enable or disable ghost mode for this session. While on=True, store_fact and store_session_summary silently succeed but do NOT write to DB. search_facts, load_context, and search_context always work normally. Ghost mode resets to off on MCP session reconnect (not persisted).

tools.name: index_recent
tools.description: Return the most recent fact operations across all agents in this tenant, newest first. Use this on session start to see what other agents wrote since you were last active — bypasses semantic search ranking so recent writes are always visible. Each entry shows: op (create/update/delete/move), namespa

tools.name: index_search
tools.description: Filtered search over the tenant activity index. Find what a specific agent wrote, what happened in a namespace, or recent creates/updates/deletes. Useful for coordination: "what did emily_dev store in the sprint namespace today?"

tools.name: index_stats
tools.description: Usage statistics from the tenant activity index: total operations, breakdown by agent, by namespace, and by day. Useful for understanding which agents are most active and where.

tools.name: invite
tools.description: Invite one person, by email, to read and write one namespace prefix of THIS account (for example project:barn). Creates a pending grant and emails them; nothing is shared until they accept with list_invites and accept_invite from their own account. Calling again for the same person and prefix return

tools.name: leave_grant
tools.description: Leave an active namespace grant as the grantee (stop using shared namespace). Server verifies grantee authorization. Grantors who want to cut off a collaborator must use revoke_grant.

tools.name: list_facts_by_key_prefix
tools.description:
Deterministic prefix scan over fact keys, optionally bounded by timestamp. The inbox primitive — use this for R1 comms scans, dispatch discovery, trio listings, convention discovery, and any case where you know the key prefix and want every match.

tools.name: list_invites
tools.description:
List this account's namespace collaboration grants: incoming invitations and outgoing shares. Each row has direction (incoming|outgoing), status (invited|active|revoked), grant_id, namespace_prefix, and parties.

An invitation referenced anywhere else (for example in an email) can be checked against

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: The places this account's memory is organised into: its own projects (anything written under project:<slug>:*, newest activity first), the workspaces other people have granted it (enter one with switch_workspace(name=<grantor>)), and, for a sharer, who they invited and whether each person accepted a

tools.name: load_context
tools.description:
Load your bootstrap context deterministically — pulls L0 (identity) + L1 (architecture) + latest L2 (state) + latest L3 (session summary).

Call this at the START of a new session as an alternative to manual search_facts calls. Returns your layered memory structured for immediate use.

Optional: pas

tools.name: mark_salient
tools.description: Salience peptide — temporarily boost a fact's retrieval ranking because it matters RIGHT NOW: an approaching deadline, a live incident, the topic under active work. The boost is small and FAST-DECAYING (max 1.4x, ~6-hour half-life — gone by tomorrow), unlike reinforce_fact which rewards confirmed ou

tools.name: move_fact
tools.description: Move a fact to a different namespace or layer without changing its content. Updates metadata in place — preserves fact_id, text, embedding, timestamp, and deprecation chain. Use for reclassifying facts (e.g. bootstrap-v2 refactor) without the storage bloat of store-new + soft-delete-old.

tools.name: reinforce_fact
tools.description:
Reward peptide — reinforce a fact whose recall LED TO A REAL GOOD OUTCOME (fix worked, deploy green, user approved). Boosts its future retrieval ranking with a bounded, time-decaying multiplier (max 1.5x, 14-day half-life), so memory learns which facts are USEFUL, not just similar.

Call this AFTER

tools.name: resume_session
tools.description: Call to load session continuity. Last session: no prior session.

tools.name: revoke_grant
tools.description: Revoke a pending invitation or active grant as the GRANTOR (owner of the shared namespace). Idempotent. Grantees use decline_invite / leave_grant.

tools.name: search_context
tools.description: Search across ingested conversations and session history for broader context. Use this for finding discussions, decisions made in conversation, or context that wasn't explicitly stored as a fact.

tools.name: search_facts
tools.description:
Search your persistent memory for stored facts.

For session bootstrap, prefer load_context() or wake_status() — they pull your identity, conventions, and latest self-note deterministically. Use search_facts when you need semantic discovery across the fact corpus.

Call this after load_context() or resume_session() to verify your bootstrap was complete

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "setup_account" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: invite, list_facts_by_key_prefix, list_invites, setup_account, wake_status, watch_events · Private data: delete_fact, get_session_seed, ghost_mode, search_facts, setup_account, store_fact · Public sink: accept_invite, decline_invite, invite, list_invites, setup_account, watch_events · Destructive: delete_fact, index_recent, list_facts_by_key_prefix, load_context, move_fact, search_facts, watch_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: invite, list_facts_by_key_prefix, list_invites, setup_account, wake_status, watch_events · Private data: delete_fact, get_session_seed, ghost_mode, search_facts, setup_account, store_fact · Public sink: accept_invite, decline_invite, invite, list_invites, setup_account, watch_events · Destructive: delete_fact, index_recent, list_facts_by_key_prefix, load_context, move_fact, search_facts, watch_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
